excerpt.zh: 自从轮回之终末带来毁灭之后，我们付出了巨大的努力进行重建。为此，我们在[solar_system.Star.GetStarName]系重建了一座哨站，这标志着[owner.GetName]的一个新的开始。
excerpt.en: We have made great efforts to recover since the destruction wrought by the End of the Cycle. To this end, we have rebuilt an Outpost in the [solar_system.Star.GetStarName] system, marking a new beginning for the [owner.GetName].
